next_esc_at.description: when to escalate to next tier

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous entry

key_hex.description: hex-encoded AES-256 key (omitted in listings, passthrough)

max_retries.description: max delivery retries within this tier

wait_sec.description: seconds to wait before escalating to next tier

device_imei.description: device IMEI or "*" for tenant-wide default

compress.description: Compress enables DEFLATE compression of IP packets before framing.

device_name.description: DeviceName is the TUN device name (e.g., "tun-ugrs0").

enabled.description: Enabled activates the tunnel. Default: false (experimental).

frag_timeout.description:
FragTimeout is how long to wait for all fragments of a packet before
discarding incomplete reassemblies.

hub_address.description: HubAddress is the Hub's IP within the tunnel subnet.

mtu.description: MTU is the IP-level MTU for the TUN device (not SBD MTU).

sbd_mtu.description:
SBDMTU is the maximum SBD payload size per frame. Iridium MT = 270,
MO = 340. Uses the smaller value (MT) by default for bidirectional safety.

tunnel_subnet.description: TunnelSubnet is the CIDR for the tunnel network.
